fases.texto_objetivo: Crew aboard Columbia ready for launch
Saturn V lifts the lunar voyage into space

ficha_info.texto: Neil Armstrong (1930-2012) was the commander of the command module of ==Apollo 11==, the first mission to bring humans to the Moon. His historic step onto the surface on ==July 20, 1969== marked the U.S. triumph in the space race, surpassing the USSR. ==First man on the Moon== is his most remembered legacy.

frases: Today, ==July 16, 1969==, we launch the giant ==Saturn V==, ==a hundred meters== tall, from Kennedy, under the gaze of the whole nation and the world.
I feel the weight of history in every second of liftoff, as if the future of humanity depended on our success.

opciones.etiqueta: What were you thinking when you saw the rocket rise?
opciones.respuesta: I saw the rocket as a symbol of hope, an answer to the race against the USSR that showed science could triumph.

opciones.etiqueta: How did you handle the pressure of the whole world?
opciones.respuesta: Rigorous training and trust in my team kept me steady; we knew every step was for peace.

frases: Our goal is to achieve the ==first Moon landing== and bring the astronauts back safely, proving that exploration is a human endeavor.

acciones.descripcion: Neil checks the panel indicators, making sure the systems are nominal.

ficha_info.texto: Buzz Aldrin (1930-2023) was the pilot of the lunar module of Apollo 11 and the ==second man== to walk on the lunar surface. His enthusiasm for engineering and exploration marked a milestone in the ==space race== against the USSR.

frases: When I saw the ==Saturn V== rise, I felt the energy of a generation that wanted to prove technology could overcome any frontier.
Every bolt and every circuit was designed to withstand the vacuum and radiation, a true work of engineering art.

opciones.etiqueta: What was the greatest technical challenge?
opciones.respuesta: Keeping the rocket engine stable during the first 2 minutes was critical; any failure would have meant the end of the mission.

opciones.etiqueta: How do you feel being the second to set foot on the Moon?
opciones.respuesta: It is an honor to share that moment with Neil; history reminds us that teamwork is essential.

frases: In the midst of the ==space race==, every step we take is also a message of peace and progress for humanity.

acciones.descripcion: Buzz adjusts his position in the seat to balance the load.

ficha_info.texto: Michael Collins (1930-2021) piloted the Columbia command module, remaining in ==lunar orbit== while his companions descended. His role was essential to the safety of the Apollo 11 mission, showing that cooperation and precision are vital in space exploration.

frases: While my companions approach the surface, I watch over the ship from lunar orbit, aware that my role is as critical as theirs.
The solitude of space reminds me of the vastness of the universe and the fragility of human life.

opciones.etiqueta: Were you scared to be alone in space?
opciones.respuesta: The silence is profound, but trust in the training and in the team dispelled any fear.

opciones.etiqueta: What were you thinking as you looked at Earth from there?
opciones.respuesta: I saw a blue planet, a sight that reinforced my commitment to peace and international cooperation.

frases: The success of this mission depends on the tireless ==support of NASA== and the determination of everyone working behind the scenes.

acciones.descripcion: Michael watches the horizon, noting the orbital alignment.

interaccion.descripcion: The ==Saturn V== is ==110 meters== tall and weighs around ==2,900 tons== at liftoff. Its five stages use liquid and solid fuels to generate the necessary thrust.

acciones.descripcion: Begins the ignition of the main engines, generating an intense glow.

interaccion.descripcion: The Columbia command module houses the astronauts' cabin. It is equipped with navigation, communication and life-support systems. Its mass is ==2,700 kg== and it contains the controls for orbital maneuvering.

acciones.descripcion: Opens the module's access hatch, revealing the internal controls.

interaccion.texto: A steel barrier with warning signage, guarding the launch zone.

interaccion.descripcion: A liquid oxygen tanker truck parked near the rocket, essential for the propulsion systems and launch safety.

zonas_narrativas.texto: Upon entering the launch pad, the player sees the enormous structure and the rocket ready for liftoff.
